| x | 4 | 8 | Q |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| y | 9 | P | 45 |

What are the values of P and Q?

A. P = 40 and Q = 13
B. P = 18 and Q = 17
C. P = 20 and Q = 18
D. P = 40 and Q = 18
E. P = 18 and Q = 20
